correctness.rationale: The hole-set transition rules are explicit. For every two-hole target, b a^d b a^t reaches it in at most 2n letters. value.rationale: Reaching thresholds are a central invariant in complete reachability and Don's conjecture. The exact maximum and unique extremizer give a sharp, parameterized benchmark at codimension two in the canonical Cerny family, separating reaching thresholds from the more familiar reset and avoiding thresholds.
